full_judgment: 3. Plaintiff's case is that admittedly one Kasum. Bhuiyan held the disputed land measuring .09 acres in Chandina Jote right under the Court of Wards on behalf of one Amullya Chandra Roy Chowdury and others. Ex-landlord of the suit Touji. It is stated by the plaintiff-respondents that the said Bhuiyan sold the disputed land to one Abbas Ali by the two registered sale deeds dated 13.5.1948. Subsequently, Abbas Ali sold .04 acres of land to the plaintiff-respondents by registered Kabalas dated 10.10.1959, 13.10.1959 and then Abbas Ali again sold .01/2 acres of land to the plaintiff No. 1 by Kabala dated 27.7.1968, Abbas Ali sold the remaining .02% acres of land to the plaintiff No. 2 wife of plaintiff No. 3 by registered Kabala dated 15.10.1960 and thus the plaintiffs acquired right, title and possession of .09 acres of land. On 29.02.1975 the plaintiffs for the first time came to know that out of the said land .07 acres was recorded in their names while the rest .02 acres was wrongly recorded in the khan khatian of the government. During the pendency of the suit defendant No.2 dispossessed the plaintiff from an area of .1/4 acres of land to the north western corner of the suit land on 10.03.1962, raised a structure thereon.
